supplements.title: Exercise inhibits proliferation and induces apoptosis of lung adenocarcinoma cells via the POU2F2-SPOCD1-PI3K/AKT signaling axis.
supplements.summary: Exercise stops lung cancer cell growth and triggers their death through a specific molecular pathway involving three key proteins.

supplements.title: A natural nephroprotective adjuvant for cancer chemotherapy: Rosmarinic acid disrupts IL-17 A-Ferroptosis coupling in Ifosfamide-induced renal injury.
supplements.summary: Rosmarinic acid protects against kidney damage from cancer chemotherapy drug Ifosfamide by blocking inflammation-related cell death pathways.

supplements.title: Integrative metabolomics and network pharmacology reveal the antifibrotic mechanisms of Gurigumu-13 in a rat model of hepatic fibrosis.
supplements.summary: Gurigumu-13, a herbal treatment, shows promise against liver fibrosis by targeting specific metabolic pathways that prevent scarring and cancer development.

supplements.title: Dose matters: a dose-stratified real-world analysis of magnesium sulfate in preventing cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity.
supplements.summary: Magnesium sulfate doses vary in protecting kidneys from cisplatin chemotherapy damage, with long-term effects still unclear.

supplements.title: Selenium nanoparticles with bioorthogonal targeting to boost CAR-cell therapy for colorectal cancer.
supplements.summary: Selenium nanoparticles enhance CAR-NK cell therapy for colorectal cancer by improving immune cell targeting and tumor infiltration.

supplements.title: Moving beyond cancer: longitudinal changes in 24-hour movement behaviors and their association with quality of life in breast cancer survivors.
supplements.summary: Combined healthy movement behaviors—exercise, light activity, reduced sitting, and sleep—improve quality of life in breast cancer survivors.

supplements.title: β-hydroxybutyrate enhances the metabolic fitness of CAR T cells in cancer.
supplements.summary: β-hydroxybutyrate boosts CAR T cell energy and function, improving tumor control across multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: Effect of vitamin D replacement on nutritional status and muscle strength in patients after allogeneic stem cell transplantation and chronic graft-versus-host disease.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D replacement therapy improved muscle strength and nutritional status in blood cancer patients recovering from stem cell transplants.

supplements.title: A resveratrol derivative RVX-208 inhibits PD-1/PD-L1 to restrain non-small cell lung cancer as an immunotherapy.
supplements.summary: RVX-208, a resveratrol derivative, enhances immune attack on non-small cell lung cancer by reducing PD-1 and PD-L1 levels.

supplements.title: Bupleurum chinense DC. Ameliorates Depression through Hepatic Lipopolysaccharide-Binding Protein-Associated Inflammation and Monoamine Biosynthesis.
supplements.summary: Bupleurum chinense, a traditional herb, reduces depression by lowering liver inflammation and boosting mood-regulating brain chemicals.

supplements.title: 1,25D3 reprograms mitochondrial quality control via sirtuin and sensitizes glioblastoma to chemotherapy.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D3 makes glioblastoma tumors more susceptible to chemotherapy by overloading their mitochondrial cleanup system.

supplements.title: INFLUENCE OF BIFIDOBACTERIUM ANIMALIS SUBSP. LACTIS BB-12 AND LACTOBACILLUS RHAMNOSUS GG ON POLARIZATION OF TUMOR-ASSOCIATED MACROPHAGES.
supplements.summary: Two probiotic strains reduced tumor-promoting immune cells in mice with Ehrlich carcinoma, potentially improving cancer immunity.

supplements.title: Dual in vitro and in silico evaluation of the apoptosis-inducing and migration-inhibiting potential of Capparis spinosa methanol extract in prostate cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Capparis spinosa plant extract triggers cell death and stops movement in prostate cancer cells through flavonoid compounds.

supplements.title: Unraveling the therapeutic potential of Elaeagnus angustifolia extract on triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC): An investigation using zebrafish model.
supplements.summary: Elaeagnus angustifolia extract safely reduced triple-negative breast cancer cell growth in zebrafish, warranting further investigation as a potential treatment.

supplements.title: Tu-Si-Zi-Wan reduces D-galactose-induced hepatic and cerebral oxidative damage in aging mice via the Nrf2/ARE pathway.
supplements.summary: Tu-Si-Zi-Wan, a traditional Chinese formula, reduces aging-related liver and brain damage in mice by activating antioxidant protective pathways.

off_label.title: Metabolic, microbial, and pharmacological stimuli elicit distinct lipidomic and cytokine responses in human placenta.
off_label.summary: Different stressors trigger distinct lipid and immune responses in placental tissue, with bacterial exposure causing inflammation linked to pregnancy complications.

off_label.title: Reprogramming innate immunity to overcome endocrine resistance in estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking STAT3 signaling in immune cells could restore hormone therapy effectiveness in resistant estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer.

off_label.title: Modulation of the HMGB1/TLR4 Pathway by Montelukast in PTZ-Induced Epilepsy: Alleviating Neuroinflammatory Oxidative Stress and Seizure Severity.
off_label.summary: Montelukast reduces seizure severity and neuroinflammation in epilepsy models, offering potential as an alternative antiepileptic treatment.

off_label.title: Cuproptosis-associated PDHA1 promotes sarcoma progression and immunotherapy responsiveness via the E2F1-PD-L1 axis: a multi-omics and clinical validation study.
off_label.summary: PDHA1 drives sarcoma progression and immune evasion through E2F1-PD-L1 signaling, offering new immunotherapy targets.

off_label.title: DNA methyltransferase inhibition is a therapeutic vulnerability in VHL-deficient renal cell carcinoma cells.
off_label.summary: DNA methyltransferase inhibitors effectively kill VHL-deficient renal cell carcinoma by reactivating a suppressed tumor-fighting gene.

off_label.title: Ferroptosis-driven in situ vaccine-like antitumor effects: NIR-triggered IFBM hydrogel synergizes with sorafenib to unleash systemic antitumor immunity.
off_label.summary: A light-activated hydrogel combined with sorafenib triggers cancer cell death, activating immune cells to fight tumors and eliminate distant metastases.

off_label.title: Distinct H3K27 methylation states drive cellular responses to the histone demethylase inhibitor GSK-J4 in ovarian cancer cells.
off_label.summary: GSK-J4 inhibitor reduces ovarian cancer cell growth by altering histone methylation, with effects dependent on androgen receptor signaling.

off_label.title: A resveratrol derivative RVX-208 inhibits PD-1/PD-L1 to restrain non-small cell lung cancer as an immunotherapy.
off_label.summary: RVX-208, a resveratrol derivative, enhances immune attack on non-small cell lung cancer by reducing PD-1 and PD-L1 levels.

off_label.title: Calcium channel blockers affect angiogenesis by modulating inflammatory factors: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
off_label.summary: Calcium channel blockers inhibit tumor blood vessel growth by reducing inflammatory factors like IL-1, IL-6, and TNF-α.

off_label.title: Sodium valproate drives propionylation-mediated epigenetic reprogramming to enhance mesothelin CAR-T cell therapy in solid tumors.
off_label.summary: Sodium valproate improves CAR-T cell therapy for ovarian and breast cancer by enhancing cell persistence, migration, and tumor-fighting ability.

off_label.title: The Influence of Extracellular Citrate in Physiological Concentration on the Proliferation of Malignant Melanoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking citrate uptake in melanoma cells with gluconate stops citrate-driven tumor growth, suggesting a new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Glutamine antagonist DON attenuates chikungunya virus-induced myositis by suppressing inflammatory activation in a murine model.
off_label.summary: DON, a glutamine inhibitor, reduces chikungunya virus-induced muscle inflammation by suppressing immune cell activation, without affecting viral control.

off_label.title: The dual role of the crosstalk between autophagy and ferroptosis in lung cancer treatment: Advances in mechanisms and therapeutic strategies (Review).
off_label.summary: Researchers found that combining autophagy and ferroptosis processes offers dual benefits for treating lung cancer through various drug combination strategies.

off_label.title: Lactylation as a metabolic-epigenetic switch in cancer: dual roles in cell death resistance and therapeutic vulnerability.
off_label.summary: Lactate-driven protein changes help cancers resist treatment, but blocking this process restores sensitivity to chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Decreased potential for lymphatic vessel generation is a hallmark of early diagnosed arterial hypertension and can be reversed by treatment with angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors.
off_label.summary: ACE inhibitor treatment restores the body's ability to generate lymphatic vessels in hypertensive patients, improving kidney function and vascular health.

biomarkers.title: Associations of breast DNA methylation-based measures of biological ageing with obesity-related breast cancer risk markers.
biomarkers.summary: Breast tissue's biological age markers show associations with obesity-related metabolic factors that may influence breast cancer risk.

biomarkers.title: Current and emerging pharmacotherapies for treating vascular malformations.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified genetic pathways in vascular malformations, enabling new drug treatments as alternatives to conventional surgery.

biomarkers.title: Cytokines at the Crossroads of Mitochondrial Dysfunction and Inflammation in Colorectal Cancer: Implications for Postoperative Complications.
biomarkers.summary: Inflammatory molecules and mitochondrial damage may help predict complications after colorectal cancer surgery.

biomarkers.title: Comparative genomic landscape of primary and metastatic bladder urothelial carcinoma in a large-scale cohort.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers compared genetic changes between primary and metastatic bladder cancer to identify differences affecting survival outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Validation of the 9th Edition of the UICC TNM classification and the prognostic impact of nodal spread in salivary gland cancer.
biomarkers.summary: The updated TNM classification for salivary gland cancer better predicts patient outcomes by improving how lymph node involvement is categorized.

biomarkers.title: Association of lncRNA AGAP11 with prognosis and malignant progression in triple-negative breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A long RNA molecule called AGAP11 may help predict outcomes and progression in aggressive triple-negative breast cancer.

biomarkers.title: Underutilization of Genetic Counseling and Germline Testing Following Abnormal Mismatch Repair Immunohistochemistry in Colorectal Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Many colorectal cancer patients with genetic markers aren't referred for genetic counseling or testing despite being eligible.

biomarkers.title: WISP2 Overexpression Is Associated with Reduced Vasculogenic Mimicry and Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition in Gastric Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Increasing WISP2 protein levels reduces tumor vessel formation and cancer cell spread in gastric cancer.

biomarkers.title: Exercise inhibits proliferation and induces apoptosis of lung adenocarcinoma cells via the POU2F2-SPOCD1-PI3K/AKT signaling axis.
biomarkers.summary: Exercise stops lung cancer cell growth and triggers their death through a specific molecular pathway involving three key proteins.

biomarkers.title: Single-cell profiling reveals MIF-mediated immune evasion and CD8 + T cell exhaustion in relapsed multiple myeloma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that a protein called MIF helps multiple myeloma cancer cells evade immune attack by exhausting CD8+ T cells, suggesting a new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: A natural nephroprotective adjuvant for cancer chemotherapy: Rosmarinic acid disrupts IL-17 A-Ferroptosis coupling in Ifosfamide-induced renal injury.
biomarkers.summary: Rosmarinic acid protects against kidney damage from cancer chemotherapy drug Ifosfamide by blocking inflammation-related cell death pathways.

biomarkers.title: Novel Resorcinol Dibenzyl Ether-Based PD-L1 Inhibitors Modulate Lipid Metabolism for Enhanced Tumor Immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new compound (ZQ8) that blocks PD-L1 and reduces tumor-promoting lipid buildup, achieving 86% tumor growth inhibition in liver cancer mouse models.

biomarkers.title: GeoMx and RNAscope: A Comparative Assessment of Their Utility for Spatial mRNA Expression Profiling in Formalin-Fixed Breast Cancer Tissue.
biomarkers.summary: GeoMx and RNAscope show strong correlation for measuring gene expression in breast cancer tissue, each offering distinct advantages in sensitivity and multiplexing capability.

biomarkers.title: BMPR2 Splice-Site Variant in a Patient With Pulmonary Arteriovenous Malformation and Delayed-Onset Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension: A Case Report and Mechanistic Phenocopy Hypothesis.
biomarkers.summary: A BMPR2 gene variant linked to heart disease was found in a patient with lung blood vessel malformations, suggesting a new disease mechanism beyond known genetic conditions.

biomarkers.title: Diagnostic Performance of CT, MRI, and ERUS in Preoperative T- and N-Staging of Colorectal Cancer: A Retrospective Single-Center Analysis.
biomarkers.summary: CT, MRI, and ultrasound imaging were compared to determine which best predicts colorectal cancer spread before surgery.

trials.title: Validation of the 9th Edition of the UICC TNM classification and the prognostic impact of nodal spread in salivary gland cancer.
trials.summary: The updated TNM classification for salivary gland cancer better predicts patient outcomes by improving how lymph node involvement is categorized.

trials.title: Underutilization of Genetic Counseling and Germline Testing Following Abnormal Mismatch Repair Immunohistochemistry in Colorectal Cancer.
trials.summary: Many colorectal cancer patients with genetic markers aren't referred for genetic counseling or testing despite being eligible.

trials.title: The development of local outpatient palliative care referral criteria for persons with advanced cancer at the University Hospital Centre Zagreb: a Delphi study.
trials.summary: Researchers created clear guidelines to help doctors refer advanced cancer patients to palliative care earlier in their treatment.

trials.summary: This study aimed to systematically analyze the clinical features, prognosis, and relapse of patients with autoimmune encephalitis associated with antibodies against cell surface antigens (AEASA), a...

trials.title: Long-term survival outcomes after biomarker-guided thromboprophylaxis in cancer: extended follow-up of the TARGET-TP randomised trial.
trials.summary: Biomarker-guided blood clot prevention improved early survival in high-risk lung and gastrointestinal cancer patients.

trials.title: PD-L1 positivity predicts a unique hyperaggressive tumor group within MenG C meningiomas.
trials.summary: PD-L1 expression identifies aggressive meningioma tumors, suggesting molecular profiling should guide future immunotherapy trials for these brain cancers.

trials.title: Oncolytic Adenoviral Infection of Chordoma Achieves Treatment Efficacy Associated with Immunologic Response and Tumor Microenvironmental Alteration.
trials.summary: A modified virus called Delta-24-RGD effectively kills chordoma cancer cells by triggering immune responses and changing the tumor environment.

trials.title: Cyclin-dependent kinases as therapeutic targets in cancer: Recent advances, challenges, and opportunities.
trials.summary: CDK inhibitors, especially targeting CDK4/6 and CDK2, show promise in breast cancer and may enhance immunotherapy when combined.

trials.title: B cells and humoral immunity in melanoma: regulatory and autoimmune-like features and implications for immunotherapy.
trials.summary: B cells regulate melanoma progression and immunotherapy response through both immune-suppressive and tumor-fighting mechanisms, offering new treatment targets.

trials.title: Whole transcriptome sequencing reveals differences in the pathogenesis of myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia.
trials.summary: Whole transcriptome sequencing identifies key genetic differences between myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia, improving diagnosis and treatment strategies.

trials.title: Importance of magnetic resonance in the diagnosis of pleomorphic parotid adenoma. Clinical case series.
trials.summary: MRI effectively identifies pleomorphic adenoma, the most common benign parotid tumor, using specialized imaging techniques.

trials.title: Prognostic factors and outcome measures after BRAF-directed targeted therapy of unresectable metastatic BRAFV600E colorectal cancer: a study cohort-level analysis.
trials.summary: BRAF inhibitors improve survival in metastatic colorectal cancer, but age and microsatellite instability status predict worse outcomes.
